proposed_check: Evaluate effective create/replace/write permissions for every code object and containing directory under every declared runtime identity using an OS-aware read-only evaluator. PASS requires complete inventory and no writable object; any confirmed writable object FAIL; unsupported capability, namespace or ACL semantics UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["Runtime UID, supplementary groups, capabilities and mount namespace for each application worker", "Complete app/vendor/lib inventory, symlink targets, ACLs and mount flags"]
rationale: Effective write access is a machine property when the deployment runtime identities and mount namespace are known. Current strict mode checks all Unix write bits, so owner-writable code can falsely fail even when the web worker cannot write; ACLs and read-only mounts are not evaluated.
limitations: Active IDs only cover world-write/env ownership policy. Never infer runtime access from scanner UID or mode bits alone.

proposed_check: New ID: each named Admin endpoint returns an explicit access denial from the configured untrusted probe origin, with active ACL bindings showing the protected route. Reachable login FAIL; ambiguous 200/404, redirect, unknown origin or unavailable binding UNKNOWN. No password submission.
required_inputs: ["Known Admin route and explicit ingress endpoint list", "Machine readable active gateway policy tied to endpoint and known denied/allowed probe perspectives"]
rationale: An ACL string anywhere in repository config and an unseen login page do not prove ingress restriction. The current check can PASS on ACL hints even if the effective virtual host does not apply them.
limitations: New ID required for endpoint/origin-scoped denial; cannot establish restriction from all networks or gateway bypass absence. Existing route naming/HTTPS checks are not Admin access controls.

proposed_check: For the explicit discovered state-changing browser route manifest, automated integration tests must reject missing/invalid token without mutation and accept a valid token only with the appropriate authenticated session; incomplete route enumeration is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["machine-readable state-changing route manifest", "isolated test deployment", "session/token fixtures", "transaction rollback or disposable records"]
rationale: An input named form_key can be empty and current detector passes it; server acceptance is untested.
limitations: Run mutation tests in isolated environment, not as a passive production probe; this is route-contract coverage rather than all possible CSRF.

proposed_check: For every HTTP-client adapter in the complete declared manifest, isolated automated tests must prove its approved destination policy rejects loopback/private/link-local destinations, DNS-change and redirect escape cases before connection, and allows the approved control. Unlisted adapters or incomplete network fixtures are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["source inventory", "HTTP client adapter manifests", "controlled DNS and redirect test service in isolated network"]
rationale: Timeout/allowlist words near a sink do not establish URL canonicalization, DNS rebinding handling or redirect controls across arbitrary application flows.
limitations: No defensible positive conclusion for the original broad requirement; arbitrary dynamic/network flows are not enumerated.

proposed_check: Completely parsed custom PHP must contain no eval, executable-string assertion, create_function or dynamic include target outside a statically resolved approved set; unresolved constructs yield UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete PHP AST inventory", "runtime PHP version", "approved include manifest"]
rationale: Detector suppresses some unresolved includes/callables and interprets assert without installed-version semantics; current absence result cannot establish broad no dynamic execution.
limitations: New precisely enumerated construct policy; dynamic language/runtime loading beyond analyzed files remains uncovered.

proposed_check: For each declared file adapter and operation, isolated automated tests must prove all defined traversal, encoding, sibling-prefix and symlink fixtures remain within the approved canonical root; supported safe paths must work and incomplete adapter/operation enumeration is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["source inventory", "file adapter manifests", "isolated symlink and encoding fixtures"]
rationale: Nearby basename/realpath/DirectoryList strings suppress reports without proving canonical containment or symlink-safe use.
limitations: General path safety depends on runtime filesystem, races, wrappers and interprocedural input flow.

proposed_check: Every upload endpoint in the complete declared manifest must satisfy its exact extension/MIME/size/authorization/generated-filename/storage-delivery contract under isolated automated fixtures; unsupported endpoint architecture or incomplete inventory is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["endpoint and allowed-content manifest", "isolated upload storage", "test users", "harmless MIME/extension mismatch fixtures"]
rationale: Generic MIME/extension/size/storage words near a save operation do not prove enforcement or non-executable delivery.
limitations: Business allowed types, image transformations, virus processing and CDN/runtime execution are broader than source inference.

proposed_check: The complete declared security-token generator manifest must resolve to approved CSPRNG APIs with configured minimum entropy and no fallback to weak generators; unresolved flow is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["machine-readable security-token generator manifest", "PHP AST/dataflow", "entropy policy"]
rationale: Current weak-PRNG detection depends on token-like nearby names; security relevance cannot be inferred from names alone.
limitations: New manifest-bound generator contract; cannot discover every security-sensitive random use by variable name.

proposed_check: Completely parsed custom PHP must use only approved crypto/session service APIs; ban a versioned exact list of raw session and obsolete crypto primitives, resolve aliases and report unresolved dynamic calls UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete source inventory", "installed PHP/Magento versions", "approved service and forbidden API policy"]
rationale: Raw APIs can be legitimate; framework name presence does not prove cryptographic or session correctness.
limitations: New syntactic/API policy; approved services can still be misused semantically.

proposed_check: Bind every configured application log sink to active rotation/retention configuration through supported host/container/cloud adapters. Resolve includes, defaults, overrides and scheduling without invoking rotation scripts. Complete configured sink coverage PASS; known unrotated sink FAIL; unsupported collector or missing include/scheduler UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["Actual application log destinations and deployment logging architecture", "Effective installed logrotate includes and schedule, or supported container/cloud collector retention configuration"]
rationale: Whether rotation is configured for deployed logs can be automatically determined from effective scheduler/collector configurations. A project devops/logrotate.conf with compression does not prove host installation, all log coverage or container/cloud applicability.
limitations: Original criterion is configured rotation, not successful historical execution. Retention/compression thresholds must be explicit policy; don't force local logrotate on managed logging.

proposed_check: Report published fixed release candidates and optional read-only solver conflicts per detected advisory; do not assert an actionable approved plan.
required_inputs: ["Complete lock inventory", "Fresh OSV branches/ranges", "Composer solver/platform context"]
rationale: An actionable remediation plan and explicitly reviewed alternative mitigation require a decision; OSV fixed-version metadata alone proves neither compatibility nor review.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: Flag enabled mapped modules matching explicit risk patterns whose known maintenance statuses violate configured recency/archive/abandonment policy.
required_inputs: ["Enabled module declarations", "Module-to-Composer mapping including non-Composer code", "Explicit risk patterns", "Known repository/release statuses"]
rationale: Maintained and high-risk are broader than pattern tagging and recent release/repository metadata; enabled module inventory must be mapped correctly to packages.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: Validate mitigation manifest schema and expiry plus references to collected advisories; explicitly assess document completeness only, not mitigation effectiveness or truthful coverage.
required_inputs: ["Machine-readable mitigation manifest", "Advisory IDs and deployment identifiers", "Owner, expiry and rollback fields"]
rationale: Existing SECURITY.md keyword checks can pass arbitrary text containing mitigation and rollback; they cannot establish that every actual temporary mitigation is documented.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: No installed collected Composer package version matches a known KEV CVE in the dated complete KEV/advisory datasets; preserve positive matches under partial coverage.
required_inputs: ["Complete advisory coverage", "CVE alias mapping", "Dated complete KEV source with explicit known membership"]
rationale: Current function detects KEV advisory matches, not organizational prioritization. Missing known_exploited fields currently look false; feed completeness/freshness is necessary.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: For explicitly classified Marketplace Composer packages, report installed-versus-policy target version and latest release age; absence of metadata is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["Complete extension inventory and enabled/deployed scope", "Verified Marketplace mapping", "Version comparability/branch constraints", "Explicit support/release metadata timestamps"]
rationale: Current/maintained cannot be inferred from latest-release age; Marketplace classification is backend metadata, and magento2-module excludes other extension package types and manually installed extensions.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: For named mapped packages, configured authoritative vendor source explicitly declares this installed version supported until a recorded date; do not infer customer entitlement from repository activity.
required_inputs: ["Authoritative vendor version lifecycle API or authenticated entitlement API", "Complete extension classification", "Timestamp and supported version ranges"]
rationale: Backend vendor_support_status active is evidence of a reported support status, not evidence that this customer/version has vendor support entitlement or support service.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: Enumerate all collected replacement and source-override candidates from complete lock/root repository declarations; resolve canonical upstream and source revision; reject candidates violating configured exact repository/revision risk policy. Unknown identity, fork state, unsupported provider or source must prevent PASS.
required_inputs: ["Complete lock plus root repository declarations", "Canonical source URLs and pinned upstream revisions", "Explicit exact source/revision allowlist", "Known per-package fork/override status"]
rationale: Risk can be an explicit machine-evaluable source policy: a complete mapping of replacements/forks/source overrides and exact approved upstreams/revisions permits a full verdict under that supplied policy. Current repository_trusted/is_fork heuristics and excluded missing sources are insufficient.
limitations: Conditional FULL under an explicit technical fork-risk policy; cannot infer absence of undisclosed malicious commits. Root repository overrides, non-Git providers, missing statuses and all installed custom libraries must be accounted for. No current authoritative revision allowlist adapter is claimed implemented.

proposed_check: For every effective endpoint in the declared Magento integration endpoint manifest, resolved production configuration must use HTTPS and the actual client configuration must enable peer/hostname verification; unsupported adapters are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["effective endpoint/adapter manifest", "resolved production config", "HTTP client TLS options", "safe TLS test endpoints"]
rationale: Source HTTP literals are neither complete effective endpoint inventory nor proof of TLS enforcement; Basic already covers storefront HTTPS and mixed-content observations.
limitations: New manifest-bound integration TLS policy; active storefront/mixed-content checks overlap but do not fully cover integration configuration.

proposed_check: Every webhook adapter in the complete declared provider manifest must reject invalid/tampered/missing/stale signatures before side effects, accept the provider valid-event control, and satisfy its idempotency contract in isolated automated tests; unknown adapters are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["provider handler manifest", "official provider contract/version", "isolated valid/tampered/replayed event fixtures", "side-effect oracle"]
rationale: Finding hash_hmac/hash_equals/signature words does not establish correct payload canonicalization, secret binding, rejection or replay handling for arbitrary webhook providers.
limitations: Provider-specific implementation is feasible per adapter but cannot certify the unrestricted original statement across unknown handlers.

proposed_check: New ID: in the named supported namespace, effective policy for the declared application identity denies new outbound traffic outside supplied destination/service allow-list. Model complete chain ordering/jumps and both address families; unsupported paths UNKNOWN. No arbitrary external connection scans.
required_inputs: ["Named runtime network namespace and supported effective firewall/CNI/gateway policy export", "Explicit destination allow-list and complete IPv4/IPv6 chain references"]
rationale: Host OUTPUT default deny alone is not deployment allow-list enforcement: jumps, broad accepts, IPv6, container FORWARD/CNI and external gateways may bypass it. Source hints cannot repair missing topology.
limitations: New ID required for supported namespace/policy model; cannot certify all production network paths from host firewall output. A DROP policy with unrestricted earlier rules must not PASS.

proposed_check: Report inspected source locations with apparent raw sensitive fields in recognized outbound flows; label as suspicion requiring investigation, never proof all third-party flows minimize PII.
required_inputs: ["Complete readable source inventory", "Configured sensitive field taxonomy", "Optional bounded representative outbound request fixtures"]
rationale: Regex detection of sensitive fields near outbound calls cannot establish business necessity, complete data flows, effective payload minimization or runtime interception; benign masked code can hide another export path.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: New ID: every successfully enumerated supplied gateway endpoint accepts only cipher suites allowed by configured baseline for assessed TLS versions. Any weak accepted suite FAIL; incomplete enumeration, unsupported client capability or unbound endpoint UNKNOWN. Source expressions are supplemental, not runtime proof.
required_inputs: ["Explicit gateway endpoint/SNI list with deployment binding", "Supported active TLS cipher enumerator and explicit versioned cipher baseline"]
rationale: Current check returns on the first apparently strong repository TLS declaration; other virtual hosts/gateways, inherited settings and TLS 1.3 cipher policy are not established. Active endpoint enumeration can support a precise observed policy.
limitations: New ID required for enumerated endpoint scope and defined strong-suite policy. Protocol/certificate checks do not cover ciphers; no browser/client failure may be interpreted as server rejection.

proposed_check: For each credential in an explicit integration-credential manifest, effective config provenance must resolve to an approved protected environment/secret-store source, and prohibited plaintext config DB fields/source literals must not contain that credential; values are compared in memory and never emitted.
required_inputs: ["credential provenance manifest", "read-only effective config/DB access", "secret-store adapter provenance", "complete source scope"]
rationale: env.php presence or a credential-like key does not prove all API keys are stored there; external secret injection may be a valid architecture contrary to this original storage mandate.
limitations: New storage/provenance criterion required; current env.php-only requirement rejects valid external secret stores and cannot enumerate unknown keys.

proposed_check: For explicitly named integrations, effective assigned ACL resources must be a subset of supplied allowed resources with no all-resource grant; separately verify named IP policy declarations through authoritative APIs. Do not claim optimal business least privilege.
required_inputs: ["Explicit integration allowlist policy", "Read-only integration/authorization_role/authorization_rule data", "Effective merged webapi ACL mappings", "Applicable network policy API and named endpoints"]
rationale: Source ACL/IP keywords do not prove effective integration privileges, endpoint access or least privilege. Business-required minimal permissions cannot be derived from code alone.
limitations: A new narrower criterion requires a new identity; do not promote the historical requirement by dropping human flags. Package API presence is not proof of backend provenance, freshness or completeness.

proposed_check: New ID: each supplied successfully retrieved checkout response emits enforced CSP satisfying configured directives after parsing each policy and applicable fallback. Report-only alone FAIL; policy split across unrelated files cannot combine into PASS; unavailable checkout/session UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["Named checkout page URLs and safe existing session context", "Successful final same-origin response headers and versioned explicit CSP baseline"]
rationale: Current implementation unions CSP directives from unrelated source files; it cannot prove a policy is emitted or enforced at checkout. Runtime response policies can be checked on named routes with explicit scope.
limitations: New ID required because named response policy is narrower than checkout-wide enforcement. Does not establish nonce/hash application, all payment flows or absence of XSS; no purchases or state-changing checkout actions.

proposed_check: Every route in the complete declared custom privileged-route manifest must reject guest and disallowed-role test requests with no protected action and accept the authorized-role control in isolated integration tests.
required_inputs: ["complete custom privileged-route manifest", "test role/user fixtures", "isolated deployment", "side-effect oracle"]
rationale: Current checker searches sensitive words and accepts authorization-looking names anywhere in the file, not executed denial paths.
limitations: New route/role contract; object ownership and unenumerated business authorization are separate.

proposed_check: No positive automated verdict for original criterion. A separately named approved-route/schema allowlist drift check is possible after a policy manifest exists.
required_inputs: ["business-approved route/schema allowlist", "effective runtime API inventory"]
rationale: Minimized exposure is a business decision about which APIs the storefront/integrations require; neither anonymous GraphQL nor public REST is inherently wrong.
limitations: The separate allowlist checker can enforce a decision, but cannot decide necessity or certify the original minimization criterion.

proposed_check: New ID: successful responses at named URLs emit unambiguous X-Content-Type-Options nosniff plus configured enforced CSP/frame protection; evaluate HSTS through MB-0027 and frame policy through MB-0779 to avoid duplicate conclusions. Missing header on valid response FAIL; unsuccessful collection UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["Explicit assessed application URL set", "Successful same-host HTTPS response headers and configured header policy"]
rationale: Baseline is underspecified and source strings are currently combined across files. A precise runtime response baseline is a defensible automated predicate; full application-wide enforcement is not inferred.
limitations: New ID required to define baseline and observation scope. Security headers do not by themselves prove input handling or complete browser security.

proposed_check: In the completely collected declared deployment source inventory, no literal matches the versioned supported credential signatures outside explicit secret-store exclusions; all unreadable/oversized eligible inputs make the result UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete source inventory", "versioned supported credential signatures", "explicit exclusions and redaction policy"]
rationale: Secret pattern absence cannot establish that no hardcoded secrets exist; an active scoped pattern predicate already overlaps this topic.
limitations: A narrower new ID or existing MB-0730 revision/coverage expansion is appropriate; no claim that arbitrary unknown secrets are absent.

proposed_check: All completely parsed custom XML-parser call sites must resolve to a versioned approved parser configuration that disables external entity expansion, external DTD loading and XInclude; unknown flags/options are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete PHP inventory", "AST constant/options evaluation", "installed PHP/libxml versions", "approved parser wrapper contract"]
rationale: Flags can be composed or supplied dynamically; current raw pattern detection does not resolve parser behavior/version.
limitations: New enumerated parser API/configuration policy, not universal assurance for third-party parsing outside collected scope.

proposed_check: Each download/export route in the complete manifest must reject guest, disallowed role and wrong-owner requests without releasing the protected test artifact, while authorized control obtains it.
required_inputs: ["download/export route manifest", "role/owner fixtures", "isolated protected artifacts", "response/content oracle"]
rationale: Route/file naming and login words cannot prove permission checks protect the exported data.
limitations: New route/role/object contract; signed-link flows need explicit expiry/scope fixture semantics.

proposed_check: Resolve inherited effective global ACL role grants and compare to configured approved role IDs. Do not silently treat omitted approval policy as empty; explicit deny-all policy is valid. Orphan/cyclic/unsupported ACL semantics UNKNOWN or assignment-integrity FAIL in MB-0100. Preserve role-only criterion rather than imposing unconfigured user allow-list.
required_inputs: ["Complete admin_user/authorization_role/authorization_rule rows and Magento ACL semantics", "Explicit approved global role policy with stable IDs and deployment binding"]
rationale: Comparison of actual effective global ACL assignments to an explicit machine policy can be automated. The decision to approve a role remains customer policy input, not human evidence per finding. Current implementation uses direct global-resource rows and also requires user approvals beyond the stated role criterion.
limitations: Approval policy must be supplied as configuration. Scanner cannot decide business necessity or least privilege; MB-0100 is only relational integrity.

proposed_check: Keep original assessment outside Magebean automated profiles. Optional new ID may detect named supported vendor default accounts from read-only inventories; never automatically attempt default passwords on production.
required_inputs: ["Vendor-specific deployed account inventory and manufacturer defaults, if a separate technical control is desired"]
rationale: Original criterion is explicitly a PCI vendor-default-account evidence assessment, not a defined technical predicate. Parsing a customer assertion JSON does not independently verify account security and cannot justify moving it to automated Magebean coverage.
limitations: PCI provenance and evidence sufficiency belong to PCI workflow. Separate default-account detection cannot certify the original assurance assessment.

proposed_check: Verify native Admin password validator rejects valid-form candidates shorter than eight and resolves an effective minimum at least eight; adapter runs validation without creating users or changing passwords. Unsupported IMS/custom authentication UNKNOWN. Prefer consolidate with MB-0728 if its existing narrower criterion remains explicit.
required_inputs: ["Effective Admin authentication mode and resolved password settings", "Installed validator version, DI preferences/plugins and supported nonmutating validation adapter"]
rationale: The minimum accepted native Admin password length can be determined from effective configuration and the installed validator. Legacy implementation reads only config.php; active MB-0728 already improves observation but does not test actual acceptance or custom validator overrides.
limitations: Does not inspect plaintext passwords or prove every existing credential meets the current policy. Eight is Magebean policy, not a universal Adobe mandate.

proposed_check: In every parsed PHP/PHTML file in the declared complete custom-code inventory, database calls must resolve to approved Magento adapters/repositories and parameter binding; unresolved dynamic receiver or query construction is UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete source inventory", "PHP AST and resolved adapter types", "approved abstraction/binding policy"]
rationale: Raw-SQL abstraction and injection safety are different properties; current regex also flags fixed SQL literals and does not resolve the connection type.
limitations: Interprocedural dynamic SQL and plugins require analysis coverage; this new policy does not prove no SQL injection.

proposed_check: Every output expression in completely parsed custom PHTML templates must use the encoder approved for its syntactic HTML/attribute/URL context or resolve to an explicitly typed trusted rendered fragment; dynamic contexts are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete template inventory", "PHP/HTML context parser", "typed trusted-fragment policy"]
rationale: Regex recognizes a subset of echoes and any escape-function name; HTML, attribute, URL and JS contexts require distinct handling.
limitations: No browser/runtime XSS guarantee; Knockout/JS-generated output is outside this new PHTML policy.

proposed_check: In completely parsed custom PHP files, no invocation may resolve to native unserialize, including namespace aliases/fully-qualified and statically resolvable indirect calls; unresolved callable targets are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete PHP inventory", "AST callable resolver", "ban-native-unserialize policy"]
rationale: Current allowed_classes=false bypass is not sufficient for untrusted data; PHP documentation explicitly warns against it.
limitations: This is a stricter API ban with a new criterion; it does not prove all serializers and object-hydration flows safe.

proposed_check: No parsed custom-code call may resolve to shell-enabled execution APIs or backticks; only approved process adapter calls with literal executable and array arguments are allowed, unresolved indirect targets are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete PHP inventory", "AST callable/dataflow analysis", "approved process adapter contract"]
rationale: Fixture shows unrelated escapeshellarg causes PASS for unguarded shell_exec; guard presence is not dataflow.
limitations: New explicit execution API policy, not proof every OS command is semantically harmless.

proposed_check: All dynamic output in completely parsed inline-script and event-handler contexts must use the approved context-specific serializer/encoder combination; unresolved script templates are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["complete PHTML/HTML inventory", "HTML and JS parser", "installed serializer contract"]
rationale: Inline JS output requires nested HTML/JS parsing; finding an encoder name is insufficient.
limitations: External JS/DOM sinks remain outside this bounded policy; no general XSS assurance.

proposed_check: For the declared application logging pipeline and sensitive-field schema, synthetic canary values must be removed or irreversibly masked before every configured sink receives each defined event fixture.
required_inputs: ["logging pipeline/handler manifest", "sensitive-field schema", "isolated sink captures", "synthetic canaries only"]
rationale: Source snippets neither enumerate downstream handlers nor prove every sensitive value is redacted.
limitations: New schema/event-bound contract; unknown sensitive fields and historical logs remain outside tested coverage.

proposed_check: Assess actual workers: Xdebug extension absent PASS under disabled-extension policy; loaded extension FAIL if that policy forbids loading, or effective off only under explicit mode policy. No public phpinfo endpoint. Incomplete fleet telemetry UNKNOWN; never substitute scanner CLI php -i.
required_inputs: ["Read-only authenticated worker-local runtime telemetry for every declared PHP pool/container", "Loaded extension list, Xdebug effective mode and environment overrides with release/pool binding"]
rationale: Loaded Xdebug extension/mode state is machine observable for actual production workers. Current repository ini scan and absence of Xdebug HTTP headers do not identify web SAPI state or environment overrides.
limitations: Define disabled semantics explicitly. Active MB-0729 covers inspected declarations only; absence of debug headers is not absence of Xdebug.

proposed_check: Verify effective display_errors is Off for each assessed runtime pool through trusted nonpublic telemetry. Enabled value FAIL, complete all-Off PASS, unavailable worker/value UNKNOWN. Do not intentionally trigger production errors as proof.
required_inputs: ["Bound read-only actual web-worker runtime settings for each deployment pool", "Effective display_errors after applicable ini/pool/runtime overrides"]
rationale: Effective display_errors is machine observable in the application PHP runtime. Current project ini parsing ignores pool/server overrides and treats every observed declaration equally instead of resolving precedence.
limitations: Point-in-time runtime value does not prove code never later changes it; unsupported request-specific overrides must remain UNKNOWN or separately scoped.

proposed_check: Resolve native template hints including applicable store inheritance for every active production scope; all resolved disabled PASS, any enabled FAIL, unknown effective value or unsupported override UNKNOWN. Deduplicate MB-0742 through a combined implementation while retaining criterion mapping.
required_inputs: ["Complete active store/website scope inventory", "Resolved env/config/DB/module defaults plus environment config overrides for template-hint paths"]
rationale: Native template-hint settings can be resolved automatically across deployment store scopes. Existing env.php-only lookup marks absent values safe and misses database/store overrides.
limitations: Active default-scope declaration check is partial. Does not assess arbitrary extension debugging output or unenumerated deployments.

proposed_check: Resolve actual default/page-cache backend selection and fallback for supported backend implementations; any file backend FAIL, every selected supported non-file backend PASS, unknown custom backend semantics UNKNOWN. Prefer consolidate with MB-0038 where declaration policy is intended.
required_inputs: ["Resolved effective default/page-cache frontend backend configuration", "Installed backend class identity/adapter mapping, Varnish applicability and runtime override inventory"]
rationale: Effective cache frontend backend identities can be inspected automatically in supported Magento deployments. Active MB-0038 already covers the declared Redis/Varnish policy; original absence-of-file backend needs resolved defaults/overrides, not a Redis-only allow-list that rejects every safe custom backend.
limitations: Cache selection is readiness policy, not proof of vulnerability or service health. Do not add a duplicate declaration check merely to restore the old count.

proposed_check: Resolve and require native template hint values disabled in every active production scope. Share collector/check with MB-0740 and consolidate duplicates if criteria are semantically equal; separately report inline translation under its own defined predicate.
required_inputs: ["All production store scopes and resolved template_hints_storefront/template_hints settings", "Installed module defaults and applicable config overrides"]
rationale: Debug template hints are native resolvable settings, but legacy check also inspects inline translation and does not resolve stores/defaults. Clarify the implementation against original hints criterion rather than conflating independent settings.
limitations: Do not count two near-duplicate template-hint requirements as two independent security capabilities. Existing active requirement covers only default-scope declarations.

proposed_check: For declared PII fields and event fixtures, every configured application-log sink must receive values transformed according to the declared masking policy; unknown sinks are UNKNOWN.
required_inputs: ["PII schema", "log sink manifest", "isolated synthetic PII fixtures"]
rationale: It reuses MB-0737 detector but PII classification is different; matching a customer/email word does not prove disclosure.
limitations: New bounded PII policy; no claim that arbitrary logs contain no PII. Share collection with MB-0737 but keep distinct conclusions.

proposed_check: Reuse MB-0061 for Composer libraries; inventory additional collected libraries with authoritative package identifiers and explicit known abandonment status for every item. Any unresolved identity or status prevents PASS.
required_inputs: ["Complete declared Composer inventory", "Per-package explicit abandonment status from dated authoritative source", "Non-Composer library inventory if claiming all libraries"]
rationale: Abandonment is an explicit package-maintenance status and can be machine-verified for a complete collected library inventory. Existing active MB-0061 already provides this for Composer libraries. Original full criterion can be satisfied only if all collected libraries are covered, including untyped/non-Composer libraries where present.
limitations: Conditional on complete collected library inventory and authoritative current per-library status. Merely filtering Composer type=library does not prove all libraries covered. This is overlap with an active check, not a net-new check for Composer-only deployments.

proposed_check: New ID: every debug/verbose setting for explicitly supported installed integration/version adapters is resolved disabled in named scopes. Unsupported integrations remain reported UNKNOWN, rather than treating absent regex matches as clean. Ordinary audit logging excluded unless vendor schema explicitly marks debug.
required_inputs: ["Installed supported integration module/version inventory", "Versioned vendor config schema mapping of actual debug/verbose paths and resolved scope values"]
rationale: Regex matching debug/logging keys and integration-like context cannot exhaust third-party integrations; ordinary enabled logging is not necessarily verbose secret-bearing debug. Current absence-of-key PASS overclaims.
limitations: New ID required for named supported integrations; cannot infer every third-party component behavior from generic key names.

proposed_check: Each declared third-party logging adapter must redact all schema-listed secret/PII canaries from request, response, exception and retry fixtures before the adapter emits to its configured sink.
required_inputs: ["SDK/logger adapter manifest", "sensitive data schema", "mock remote services", "captured isolated sinks"]
rationale: Third-party API responses and nested SDK log processors can bypass superficial redact-string matches.
limitations: New adapter-contract policy; newly introduced integrations need manifest updates.

proposed_check: New ID: no configured PHP opening-tag, executable-extension or script-handler signatures in readable eligible files across named upload paths; eligible unreadable/oversized files or unfollowed symlinks UNKNOWN. Extend active MB-0780 only within its filename predicate, not as proof of all executable-code absence.
required_inputs: ["Complete bounded upload path inventory", "Configured signature/extension policy and server handler inventory"]
rationale: Arbitrary executable content cannot be excluded by a finite signature set; current legacy detector skips oversized/unreadable files and can PASS an empty inventory.
limitations: New ID required because a signature policy is weaker than absence of executable code. Never execute suspected files; filename inventory does not establish server execution prevention.
